messages:
sara_sales: Heads-up: OrionX execs pushed for go/no-go. POC blocked on two things: the security questionnaire (they want org-wide attestation on KMS/HSM + network diagrams) and final pricing delta for Dedicated capacity. Need owners. @mike_se @eli_pricing

mike_se: On it. Can someone drop the latest sec questionnaire PDF or link? I need to check network diagram ask vs what we have.

anika_ce: I have the CICD/network diagrams but they're high level. @jordan_eng can you produce an anonymized infra diagram + egress flow for VPC deployment by EOD? Customer needs it for CISO review.

jordan_eng: Yep, can do. Will strip internal hostnames. ETA 5pm PT. Any required ports/details I should call out?

sara_sales: They asked for outbound-only egress, TLS1.2+, and IP allowlist options. Also need confirmation on KMS: BYOK supported? and logs retention for audit.

eli_pricing: Pricing question: OrionX wants a committed monthly for Dedicated with 99.9% latency SLA and priority routing — they expect 30% discount vs list. We need a quick model: committed GPU hours + burst; what baseline should I use? @sara_sales share expected qps and seq len.

sara_sales: They're planning ~120 avg QPS, 95th seq ~512 tokens, peak 300 QPS during batch jobs. POC 6 weeks, expected ramp to 1-2M tokens/day. They're pushing for a cap on overages.

eli_pricing: OK. I'll put together two options: Reserved 2x A100-equivalent with burst to 4x, and a Hosted fallback. Will include overage cap language for pilot. Draft by tomorrow morning.

mike_se: On sec Q: we can confirm BYOK with KMS integration, HSM-backed keys if they require. Need legal confirmation for attestation language. @anika_ce do we have standard attestation template?

anika_ce: We have a SOC2 + ISO attestation pack but not custom KMS attestation. Legal will need to sign. I'll loop in legal and get a statement template.

ops_bot: Incident Bot: Note — upcoming maintenance window 2024-05-14 03:00-03:30 UTC; no impact to Hosted API. (FYI)

sara_sales: :thumbsup: Thanks. Critical path items: 1) infra diagram + egress specifics (Jordan), 2) KMS attestation + legal (Anika), 3) Pricing draft + overage language (Eli). Can we track in a consolidated thread and sync 1pm PT tomorrow? @everyone

jordan_eng: Uploading anon diagram to shared drive: https://drive.redwood/orionx/infra-diagram.png — will update with ports. (I'll link final)

eli_pricing: Pricing draft posted: https://docs.redwood/pricing/orionx-pilot-draft — comments welcome. I'll highlight committed GPU hrs and suggested discount tiers.

anika_ce: Spun up legal ticket: LEG-7839. Assigned to @sara_sales for customer consent. ETA 24h.

sara_sales: Perfect. I'll ping OrionX CISO and exec sponsor after we have the diagram + draft attestation. Thanks team. Marking this thread 'owner: sara_sales' for follow-up.
